Subject: Observability add-ons: retention/tracing/dashboard pricing questions

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — it was helpful to see the new tracing UI and the advanced dashboards. Our engineering team is aligned on trying a short pilot, but procurement needs clarity on how you price observability add-ons so we can budget and route approval. Specifically: 

- Retention: can you break down tiered pricing (30/90/365 days) and whether we can amortize long-term retention credits across a multi-year commit?
- Tracing: are spans billed per ingested span or via an index/storage unit?
- Dashboards: does your advanced dashboard SKU require per-seat licensing, or is there a seatless option tied to metrics volume?

We have a preferred runway of a 90-day pilot (small ingest) and then a production commit if things look good. Procurement asked if there are pilot credits or temporary discounts, and whether terms around data residency/SLA are available.

Looping in procurement above — Emily, could you share a short pricing sheet and an example SOW/contract redline we can put in front of our legal team?

Thanks,
Emily Carter
Product Ops, Ava Health

From: markus_klein@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention/tracing/dashboard pricing questions

Emily — thanks for the notes and great questions. I put together a concise starter sheet and a draft SOW for procurement to review. High level answers first, then a proposal attached.

Quick answers:
- Retention: tiered per-GB storage pricing with a long-tail discount at annual commit. We can amortize credits across a multi-year commitment; see tab "Credits & Amortization" in the attached spreadsheet.
- Tracing: spend is primarily by ingested trace event (sampled spans) aggregated into 'trace units' — we include an initial free sampling buffer for the pilot.
- Dashboards: we offer both seat-based (full editor seats) and seatless 'view-only' bundles tied to metrics volume. For customers wanting a seatless experience, we map dashboards to a metrics ingest tier + a fixed view bundle.

Proposal highlights (attached):
- 90-day pilot: $0 invoice, includes 25k credits for retention/storage and 100k trace events sampled free.
- Year-1 commercial: 25% off list for retention tiers if you commit to 12 months of the selected tier; dashboards: 20% off editor seats or a 15% discount on the seatless bundle when paired with the retention commit.
- SLA/Data residency: we can include a standard data residency clause for us-east and an SLA appendix — I attached a draft SOW.

Next steps:
1) Procurement: review attached SOW and let me know redlines.
2) Engineering: if you want, we can spin up a trial environment and run a short mapping exercise (30–60 minutes) to validate trace sampling rates.

Attaching: AvaHealth_Retention_Pricing_v3.xlsx, SOW-draft-AvaHealth-obs.pdf

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Emily — thanks for the quick turnaround. We've updated the worked example and tightened commercial language per procurement's ask. Summary below and attached are the updated pricing workbook and a short redline for an amortized-credit clause you can drop into the SOW.

Worked example (illustrative monthly bill for a 12 TB/month ingest, 7% trace sample):
- Raw ingest: 12,000 GB/month
- Retention tier pricing (list): 30d = $0.025/GB, 90d = $0.018/GB, 365d = $0.011/GB
- Example (90d selected): storage cost = 12,000 * $0.018 = $216/month (note: snapshot/compaction adds ~10% to storage in practice)
- Tracing: 7% sample on 1M requests/day -> ~2.1M sampled spans/month -> trace units billed at 0.0005 USD per sampled span = ~$1,050/month before free buffer
- Dashboards: seatless bundle at selected metrics tier = $1,200/mo list -> with pairing and 15% discount = $1,020/mo
- Net (year-1 with proposed concessions): retention w/30% applied = $151/mo; tracing after pilot buffer = ~$800/mo; dashboards = $1,020/mo -> illustrative net ~ $1,971/mo

Commercial concessions (final proposed):
- Pilot: 50k retention credits + 200k trace sample budget if SOW signed within 14 days (pilot window: 90 days).
- Year-1: 30% off retention tiers on 12-month commit with 9-month prepay; dashboards: 20% off editor seats OR 15% off seatless bundle when paired with retention commit.
- Amortization clause (redline included): credits are accounted pro-rata across the contract term and applied to monthly invoices; unused credits expire 90 days after contract anniversary unless a renewal or extension is executed.
- VPC connector: one-time setup $12k or waived with Dedicated capacity purchase; $1k/mo ongoing dedicated egress/monitoring fee (waiver subject to Dedicated commitment level).

Attached: AvaHealth_Retention_Pricing_v3.xlsx (worked example tab), SOW-draft-AvaHealth-obs.pdf (redline clause included).

If this looks good, I'll ask legal to generate a SOW with the redline clause and procurement can route for signature. Happy to schedule a 30-minute call with engineering to validate the trace sampling numbers next week.

Best regards,
Markus Klein
